summary.text: Marcia Morey is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 30 since 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former district court judge, she served on the bench of North Carolina's 14th Judicial District from 1999 to 2017.

paragraphs.text: Marcia Morey earned an undergraduate degree from Millikin University in Illinois, a master's degree in education from Reed College, and a law degree from Northwestern University Law School.
Her professional experience includes service as an assistant district attorney for the 14th Judicial District.

Morey was a district court judge for the 14th Judicial District, which serves Durham County, from 1999 to 2017, and was chief district court judge from January 1, 2011, until her appointment to the state House on April 5, 2017.
She succeeded Philip Lehman in District 30.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Appropriations, Appropriations on Justice and Public Safety, Education - K-12, Families, Children, and Aging Policy, and Judiciary II committees.
The Democratic primary for her seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
